title: Exclusive: ‘When it comes to recording our lives, I believe there is a line AI cannot cross’. Here's what Insta360's founder and CEO told me when I asked about his controversial ‘photography robot’ vision
excerpt: Insta360 could make its cameras more intelligent and autonomous, but its founder wants to reassure us that human experience and creativity remain at the fore
content_html:
Insta360 founder and CEO Liu Jingkang, aka 'JK', recently shared a potentially controversial post on Chinese social media platform Weibo, which translated reads:

“Our product vision is to build a ‘Cameraman’ — an intelligent photography robot capable of automatically composing shots and capturing moments like a professional photographer, allowing users to remain fully immersed in the present.

"Today, AI is rapidly evolving, we believe the Cameraman’s 'brain' is becoming increasingly capable, unlocking new possibilities for creative imaging.

"In the long term, the ideal end state for cameras is to progressively become imperceptible, even to ‘disappear,’ until recording no longer consumes effort and becomes a natural part of life.”

As a concerned photographer (and as a concerned human being) I wrote a response to that post, and asked Insta360 for comment.

JK provided me with a statement addressing my concerns and elaborating on his vision, and he and Insta360 also answered a number of specific questions I put to them about the company's potentially game-changing plans for its future cameras.

Below you'll find JK's response, followed by my interview with JK and an Insta360 spokesperson.

JK's response: I’ve always believed imaging serves three fundamental human needs: to record, to share, and to create.

AI will undoubtedly reshape parts of this industry, especially in sharing and commercial creation. But when it comes to recording our lives, I believe there is a line AI cannot cross. Technology can make tools easier to use, but it cannot replace the human qualities behind truly meaningful work — judgment, emotion, taste, and the creative energy that come from lived experience.

For me, a photo I take of my daughter’s smile is priceless not because of technical perfection, but because I was there. I felt that moment. AI can generate, enhance, and imitate, but it cannot experience life on our behalf.

Human beings are the measure of all things. You should not hand over experiences that ought to belong to you to algorithms and machines.

So when we talk about the future of the camera, we are not talking about replacing people. We are talking about building tools that help people capture life more freely, more naturally, and with less friction. The future is not about making machines more human — it is about helping humans be more present, more creative, and more themselves.

The interview

TC: What does this 'cameraman' look like? Is it one entity or multiple products?

JK: For us, the future cameraman is a product vision rather than a single device.

Insta360: The core idea is to create a camera that can automatically compose shots, capture key moments, and produce finished content for the user, so people can stay fully immersed in the moment without missing what matters.

When you’re traveling or watching a live event, you often end up holding up a phone the entire time and looking at the screen instead of the experience itself. Our long-term vision is for the camera to work more like a professional photographer: you stay present, and it helps take care of the filming for you.

We’re still exploring what the ideal form factor looks like, so in the near term there won’t be one final ultimate product. But we’re already bringing elements of that vision into existing products. For example, Luna Ultra's POV head tracker enables a more seamless, almost invisible shooting experience, and we see that as an important early form of the future cameraman.

TC: Are we to take it that the 'intelligent photography robot' will be fully automated and independent?

Insta360: First, it’s important to clarify that the future cameraman doesn’t mean a humanoid robot. It’s a product concept and a long-term vision for how cameras should evolve.

The idea is to free users from complicated operation so they can be truly present in the moment while still getting professional-looking results. In that sense, the camera starts to play more of the role of a photographer. Imagine a family outing where the system can automatically frame, capture, edit, and output content end-to-end, without someone constantly needing to manage the device.

That said, this isn’t about a camera acting independently without the user. It’s about highly intelligent operation under user direction, intent, and control. The camera should be able to automate far more of the process, including recording comprehensively when the user wants it to, but always within boundaries set by the user. Our goal is for the experience to feel effortless and natural — even to the point where the camera becomes almost imperceptible in everyday life.

TC: Can you describe the composing, shooting and editing functionalities?

Insta360: To build the future cameraman, a camera needs to do three things well: see, understand, and act.

First, it needs to see more of the world. That’s one reason 360 imaging matters so much to us. A traditional camera captures only a narrow frame, while a 360 camera captures the full scene. That gives both the user and the AI much more context, reduces the risk of missing important moments, and creates a stronger foundation for tracking, reframing, and scene understanding.

Second, it needs spatial intelligence. The camera has to understand depth, motion, orientation, and what’s happening in the environment — not just record pixels, but actually interpret the scene.

Third, it needs to act in real time. That means tracking subjects, stabilizing footage, composing shots, predicting movement, and eventually making smarter filming decisions automatically based on the user’s intent. If it can’t respond instantly, it doesn’t really behave like a cameraman.

JK: The cameraman sits at the intersection of sensing, on-device AI, and computational imaging. The goal is for the camera to stop being just a recording tool and start becoming an active creative partner.

TC: Could you unpack a specific future feature being explored that leads Insta360's camera to being an 'active creative partner'?

Insta360: When we talk about an ‘active creative partner,’ we mean an intelligent imaging solution that better understands the scene and helps users capture it more intelligently. In dynamic environments, it can keep up with subjects with less user intervention, so people can stay focused on the moment while the camera handles more of the technical work.

To support that vision, we’ve already built a strong technical foundation, including panoramic generation and a panoramic metric depth model. We’ve already open-sourced these technologies for the industry, and they have potential applications not only in 360 cameras, but in other products and fields as well.

TC: How is the 'cameraman' different from existing cameras and Insta360 models?

Insta360: Insta360 already has some of the foundational capabilities needed for the future cameraman. Features like AI stitching, FlowState stabilization, subject tracking, reframing, auto-editing, and on-device image processing are all part of the camera’s evolution toward more intelligent and autonomous capture. That said, today’s products are still early versions of what that fully realized experience could become.

We’ve spent years building deep expertise in 360 imaging, and that gives us a strong foundation in spatial intelligence. Compared with a traditional camera that records only a single frame, 360 imaging data provides a complete field of view and continuous spatial context. Combined with our work in spatial modeling and generative intelligence, that helps AI move from simply “seeing” the world toward actually understanding it.

That’s a key difference in how we think about the future of imaging. And going forward, we’ll continue investing in areas like panoramic depth estimation, world models, and autonomous follow systems.

TC: What's the timescale for this 'cameraman'?

Insta360: This is a long-term vision, and we expect to realize it through continuous product iteration over time. Rather than arriving all at once in a single product, we see it developing step by step as the underlying technologies mature and become ready for real-world use.

TC: Does this 'cameraman' record autonomously? If so, couldn't that be a privacy concern?

Insta360: This is one of the most important questions in the age of AI hardware. Our view is that future intelligent imaging devices should be able to automate recording much more deeply — even to the point of capturing everything the user wants preserved — but always under the user’s authorization and control.

The core idea behind cameraman is not uncontrolled, limitless recording. It’s about turning the camera from a manually operated tool into an intelligent companion that understands what the user wants to capture and helps do that more effectively. That may require environmental awareness and autonomous recording when the user explicitly enables them, but those capabilities should always be bounded by clear user intent, permissions, and controls.

In other words, autonomy is important, but user agency is essential. We believe that’s the right balance for the future of intelligent imaging.

TC: Does Insta360 envision the system ultimately replacing professional content creators, or is the vision aimed at consumers?

Insta360: No — this is not about replacing photographers, videographers, or creators. It is mainly about helping consumers capture moments more easily, with less friction and less fear of missing the shot.

For professionals, we see these capabilities as assistive tools, not substitutes for human creativity. Great photography and filmmaking still depend on judgment, storytelling, taste, and human connection. Our goal is to reduce technical friction in capture, not replace the creator behind the camera.

The right side of the line?

It remains to be seen just how autonomous Insta360 cameras could become, but Insta360's response somewhat allays my fears about where its camera tech could be heading. And I get the logic — the ease of use and streamlined workflow of Insta360's consumer cameras in particular, which include leading 360-degree and vlogging cameras, are integral to their success.

Cameras such as the Insta360 X5, and Insta360's companion app are already packed with smart tools that make 360-degree video content easier to capture and edit. So, thinking ahead, why make the process unnecessarily difficult for the sake of user agency, when an intelligent camera knows which direction to point in?

Why pour over lengthy 360-degree video clips to manually piece together an edit, when AI knows where the best action is happening and can suggest / make the edit for you?

It's this intersection of human creativity and automated AI tools where we might start to see more intelligent functions assisting users in shooting, editing and sharing, freeing them up to "be more present" as JK puts it, rather than being bogged down with camera operation. And if any company is in the position to advance this kind of intelligent camera tech, it's Insta360.

Tim joined the TechRadar team as Cameras Editor in 2023 and has enjoyed more than 15 years as a tech journalist specializing in camera gear. He's previously worked at Amateur Photographer, for a photo accessory manufacturer and as a freelance photographer and video producer, with clients including Studio 44 and Canon. He also started a media team in Nairobi, Kenya, where he lived for a few years volunteering for a faith-based organisation. Tim is married, father of three children, and loves being active, primarily running since hanging up his football boots.

sentences.en: TC: What does this 'cameraman' look like?
sentences.zh: TC：这位“摄影师”长什么样？

sentences.en: Is it one entity or multiple products?
sentences.zh: 是一个实体还是多个产品？

blocks.html_en: JK: For us, the future cameraman is a product vision rather than a single device.

sentences.en: JK: For us, the future cameraman is a product vision rather than a single device.
sentences.zh: JK：对我们来说，未来的摄影师是一个产品愿景，而不是一个单一的设备。

blocks.html_en: Insta360: The core idea is to create a camera that can automatically compose shots, capture key moments, and produce finished content for the user, so people can stay fully immersed in the moment without missing what matters.

sentences.en: Insta360: The core idea is to create a camera that can automatically compose shots, capture key moments, and produce finished content for the user, so people can stay fully immersed in the moment without missing what matters.
sentences.zh: Insta360：核心理念是创建一款能够自动构图、捕捉关键时刻并为用户生成成品内容的相机，让人们能够完全沉浸在当下而不会错过重要的事情。

blocks.html_en: When you’re traveling or watching a live event, you often end up holding up a phone the entire time and looking at the screen instead of the experience itself. Our long-term vision is for the camera to work more like a professional photographer: you stay present, and it helps take care of the filming for you.

sentences.en: When you’re traveling or watching a live event, you often end up holding up a phone the entire time and looking at the screen instead of the experience itself.
sentences.zh: 当您旅行或观看现场活动时，您通常会一直拿着手机，看屏幕而不是体验本身。

sentences.en: Our long-term vision is for the camera to work more like a professional photographer: you stay present, and it helps take care of the filming for you.
sentences.zh: 我们的长期愿景是让相机更像专业摄影师：您留在现场，它可以帮助您进行拍摄。

blocks.html_en: We’re still exploring what the ideal form factor looks like, so in the near term there won’t be one final ultimate product. But we’re already bringing elements of that vision into existing products. For example, Luna Ultra's POV head tracker enables a more seamless, almost invisible shooting experience, and we see that as an important early form of the future cameraman.

sentences.en: We’re still exploring what the ideal form factor looks like, so in the near term there won’t be one final ultimate product.
sentences.zh: 我们仍在探索理想的外形尺寸，因此短期内不会有最终的最终产品。

sentences.en: But we’re already bringing elements of that vision into existing products.
sentences.zh: 但我们已经将这一愿景的元素带入现有产品中。

sentences.en: For example, Luna Ultra's POV head tracker enables a more seamless, almost invisible shooting experience, and we see that as an important early form of the future cameraman.
sentences.zh: 例如，Luna Ultra 的 POV 头部跟踪器可实现更加无缝、几乎隐形的拍摄体验，我们将其视为未来摄影师的重要早期形式。

blocks.html_en: TC: Are we to take it that the 'intelligent photography robot' will be fully automated and independent?

sentences.en: TC: Are we to take it that the 'intelligent photography robot' will be fully automated and independent?
sentences.zh: TC：我们是否认为“智能摄影机器人”将是完全自动化和独立的？

blocks.html_en: Insta360: First, it’s important to clarify that the future cameraman doesn’t mean a humanoid robot. It’s a product concept and a long-term vision for how cameras should evolve.

sentences.en: Insta360: First, it’s important to clarify that the future cameraman doesn’t mean a humanoid robot.
sentences.zh: Insta360：首先需要澄清的是，未来的摄影师并不是指人形机器人。

sentences.en: It’s a product concept and a long-term vision for how cameras should evolve.
sentences.zh: 这是一个产品概念，也是相机如何发展的长期愿景。

blocks.html_en: The idea is to free users from complicated operation so they can be truly present in the moment while still getting professional-looking results. In that sense, the camera starts to play more of the role of a photographer. Imagine a family outing where the system can automatically frame, capture, edit, and output content end-to-end, without someone constantly needing to manage the device.

sentences.en: The idea is to free users from complicated operation so they can be truly present in the moment while still getting professional-looking results.
sentences.zh: 其想法是将用户从复杂的操作中解放出来，这样他们就可以真正享受当下，同时仍然获得专业的结果。

sentences.en: In that sense, the camera starts to play more of the role of a photographer.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，相机开始更多地扮演摄影师的角色。

sentences.en: Imagine a family outing where the system can automatically frame, capture, edit, and output content end-to-end, without someone constantly needing to manage the device.
sentences.zh: 想象一次家庭郊游，系统可以自动端到端地构图、捕捉、编辑和输出内容，而无需有人不断管理设备。

blocks.html_en: That said, this isn’t about a camera acting independently without the user. It’s about highly intelligent operation under user direction, intent, and control. The camera should be able to automate far more of the process, including recording comprehensively when the user wants it to, but always within boundaries set by the user. Our goal is for the experience to feel effortless and natural — even to the point where the camera becomes almost imperceptible in everyday life.

sentences.en: That said, this isn’t about a camera acting independently without the user.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，这并不是说相机在没有用户的情况下独立运行。

sentences.en: It’s about highly intelligent operation under user direction, intent, and control.
sentences.zh: 这是关于在用户指导、意图和控制下的高度智能操作。

sentences.en: The camera should be able to automate far more of the process, including recording comprehensively when the user wants it to, but always within boundaries set by the user.
sentences.zh: 相机应该能够自动化更多的过程，包括在用户想要的时候进行全面记录，但始终在用户设置的范围内。

sentences.en: Our goal is for the experience to feel effortless and natural — even to the point where the camera becomes almost imperceptible in everyday life.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是让体验变得轻松自然——甚至在日常生活中几乎察觉不到相机的存在。

sentences.en: In future, could Insta360 might make cameras such as the Luna Ultra (above) fully autonomous?
sentences.zh: 未来，Insta360 能否使 Luna Ultra（上图）等相机完全自主化？

sentences.en: (Image credit: Future / Tim Coleman)
sentences.zh: （图片来源：未来/蒂姆·科尔曼）

blocks.html_en: TC: Can you describe the composing, shooting and editing functionalities?

sentences.en: TC: Can you describe the composing, shooting and editing functionalities?
sentences.zh: TC：您能描述一下构图、拍摄和剪辑功能吗？

blocks.html_en: Insta360: To build the future cameraman, a camera needs to do three things well: see, understand, and act.

sentences.en: Insta360: To build the future cameraman, a camera needs to do three things well: see, understand, and act.
sentences.zh: Insta360：要打造未来的摄影师，相机需要做好三件事：观察、理解和行动。

blocks.html_en: First, it needs to see more of the world. That’s one reason 360 imaging matters so much to us. A traditional camera captures only a narrow frame, while a 360 camera captures the full scene. That gives both the user and the AI much more context, reduces the risk of missing important moments, and creates a stronger foundation for tracking, reframing, and scene understanding.

sentences.en: First, it needs to see more of the world.
sentences.zh: 首先，它需要看到更多的世界。

sentences.en: That’s one reason 360 imaging matters so much to us.
sentences.zh: 这就是 360 度成像对我们如此重要的原因之一。

sentences.en: A traditional camera captures only a narrow frame, while a 360 camera captures the full scene.
sentences.zh: 传统相机只能捕捉窄幅画面，而 360 度相机则捕捉整个场景。

sentences.en: That gives both the user and the AI much more context, reduces the risk of missing important moments, and creates a stronger foundation for tracking, reframing, and scene understanding.
sentences.zh: 这为用户和人工智能提供了更多的背景信息，降低了错过重要时刻的风险，并为跟踪、重构和场景理解奠定了更坚实的基础。

blocks.html_en: Second, it needs spatial intelligence. The camera has to understand depth, motion, orientation, and what’s happening in the environment — not just record pixels, but actually interpret the scene.

sentences.en: Second, it needs spatial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 其次，它需要空间智能。

sentences.en: The camera has to understand depth, motion, orientation, and what’s happening in the environment — not just record pixels, but actually interpret the scene.
sentences.zh: 相机必须了解深度、运动、方向以及环境中发生的事情——不仅仅是记录像素，而是实际解释场景。

blocks.html_en: Third, it needs to act in real time. That means tracking subjects, stabilizing footage, composing shots, predicting movement, and eventually making smarter filming decisions automatically based on the user’s intent. If it can’t respond instantly, it doesn’t really behave like a cameraman.

sentences.en: Third, it needs to act in real time.
sentences.zh: 第三，它需要实时行动。

sentences.en: That means tracking subjects, stabilizing footage, composing shots, predicting movement, and eventually making smarter filming decisions automatically based on the user’s intent.
sentences.zh: 这意味着跟踪拍摄对象、稳定镜头、构图、预测运动，并最终根据用户的意图自动做出更明智的拍摄决策。

sentences.en: If it can’t respond instantly, it doesn’t really behave like a cameraman.
sentences.zh: 如果它不能立即做出反应，它就不像一个摄影师。

blocks.html_en: JK: The cameraman sits at the intersection of sensing, on-device AI, and computational imaging. The goal is for the camera to stop being just a recording tool and start becoming an active creative partner.

sentences.en: JK: The cameraman sits at the intersection of sensing, on-device AI, and computational imaging.
sentences.zh: JK：摄影师处于传感、设备上人工智能和计算成像的交叉点。

sentences.en: The goal is for the camera to stop being just a recording tool and start becoming an active creative partner.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是让相机不再只是一个记录工具，而开始成为一个积极的创意伙伴。

blocks.html_en: TC: Could you unpack a specific future feature being explored that leads Insta360's camera to being an 'active creative partner'?

sentences.en: TC: Could you unpack a specific future feature being explored that leads Insta360's camera to being an 'active creative partner'?
sentences.zh: TC：您能否介绍一下正在探索的一项特定的未来功能，该功能将引导 Insta360 的相机成为“积极的创意合作伙伴”？

blocks.html_en: Insta360: When we talk about an ‘active creative partner,’ we mean an intelligent imaging solution that better understands the scene and helps users capture it more intelligently. In dynamic environments, it can keep up with subjects with less user intervention, so people can stay focused on the moment while the camera handles more of the technical work.

sentences.en: Insta360: When we talk about an ‘active creative partner,’ we mean an intelligent imaging solution that better understands the scene and helps users capture it more intelligently.
sentences.zh: Insta360：当我们谈论“活跃的创意合作伙伴”时，我们指的是能够更好地理解场景并帮助用户更智能地捕捉场景的智能成像解决方案。

sentences.en: In dynamic environments, it can keep up with subjects with less user intervention, so people can stay focused on the moment while the camera handles more of the technical work.
sentences.zh: 在动态环境中，它可以在用户干预较少的情况下跟上拍摄对象，因此人们可以在相机处理更多技术工作的同时专注于瞬间。

blocks.html_en: To support that vision, we’ve already built a strong technical foundation, including panoramic generation and a panoramic metric depth model. We’ve already open-sourced these technologies for the industry, and they have potential applications not only in 360 cameras, but in other products and fields as well.

sentences.en: To support that vision, we’ve already built a strong technical foundation, including panoramic generation and a panoramic metric depth model.
sentences.zh: 为了支持这一愿景，我们已经建立了强大的技术基础，包括全景生成和全景度量深度模型。

sentences.en: We’ve already open-sourced these technologies for the industry, and they have potential applications not only in 360 cameras, but in other products and fields as well.
sentences.zh: 我们已经将这些技术开源给业界，它们不仅在360度摄像机上有潜在的应用，在其他产品和领域也有潜在的应用。

blocks.html_en: TC: How is the 'cameraman' different from existing cameras and Insta360 models?

sentences.en: TC: How is the 'cameraman' different from existing cameras and Insta360 models?
sentences.zh: TC：“摄影师”与现有相机和 Insta360 型号有何不同？

blocks.html_en: Insta360: Insta360 already has some of the foundational capabilities needed for the future cameraman. Features like AI stitching, FlowState stabilization, subject tracking, reframing, auto-editing, and on-device image processing are all part of the camera’s evolution toward more intelligent and autonomous capture. That said, today’s products are still early versions of what that fully realized experience could become.

sentences.en: Insta360: Insta360 already has some of the foundational capabilities needed for the future cameraman.
sentences.zh: Insta360：Insta360 已经具备了未来摄影师所需的一些基础功能。

sentences.en: Features like AI stitching, FlowState stabilization, subject tracking, reframing, auto-editing, and on-device image processing are all part of the camera’s evolution toward more intelligent and autonomous capture.
sentences.zh: AI 拼接、FlowState 稳定、主题跟踪、重新取景、自动编辑和设备内图像处理等功能都是相机向更智能和自主拍摄方向发展的一部分。

sentences.en: That said, today’s products are still early versions of what that fully realized experience could become.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，今天的产品仍然是完全实现的体验的早期版本。

blocks.html_en: We’ve spent years building deep expertise in 360 imaging, and that gives us a strong foundation in spatial intelligence. Compared with a traditional camera that records only a single frame, 360 imaging data provides a complete field of view and continuous spatial context. Combined with our work in spatial modeling and generative intelligence, that helps AI move from simply “seeing” the world toward actually understanding it.

sentences.en: We’ve spent years building deep expertise in 360 imaging, and that gives us a strong foundation in spatial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我们花费数年时间在 360 度成像领域积累了深厚的专业知识，这为我们在空间智能方面奠定了坚实的基础。

sentences.en: Compared with a traditional camera that records only a single frame, 360 imaging data provides a complete field of view and continuous spatial context.
sentences.zh: 与仅记录单帧的传统相机相比，360 度成像数据提供了完整的视野和连续的空间背景。

sentences.en: Combined with our work in spatial modeling and generative intelligence, that helps AI move from simply “seeing” the world toward actually understanding it.
sentences.zh: 结合我们在空间建模和生成智能方面的工作，这有助于人工智能从简单地“看到”世界转向真正理解世界。

blocks.html_en: That’s a key difference in how we think about the future of imaging. And going forward, we’ll continue investing in areas like panoramic depth estimation, world models, and autonomous follow systems.

sentences.en: That’s a key difference in how we think about the future of imaging.
sentences.zh: 这是我们对成像未来的看法的一个关键区别。

sentences.en: And going forward, we’ll continue investing in areas like panoramic depth estimation, world models, and autonomous follow systems.
sentences.zh: 展望未来，我们将继续投资全景深度估计、世界模型和自主跟随系统等领域。

blocks.html_en: TC: What's the timescale for this 'cameraman'?

sentences.en: TC: What's the timescale for this 'cameraman'?
sentences.zh: TC：这位“摄影师”的拍摄时间是多少？

blocks.html_en: Insta360: This is a long-term vision, and we expect to realize it through continuous product iteration over time. Rather than arriving all at once in a single product, we see it developing step by step as the underlying technologies mature and become ready for real-world use.

sentences.en: Insta360: This is a long-term vision, and we expect to realize it through continuous product iteration over time.
sentences.zh: Insta360：这是一个长期的愿景，我们期望通过随着时间的推移不断的产品迭代来实现它。

sentences.en: Rather than arriving all at once in a single product, we see it developing step by step as the underlying technologies mature and become ready for real-world use.
sentences.zh: 我们看到它并不是一次性在单一产品中实现，而是随着底层技术的成熟并为实际使用做好准备而逐步发展。

blocks.html_en: TC: Does this 'cameraman' record autonomously? If so, couldn't that be a privacy concern?

sentences.en: TC: Does this 'cameraman' record autonomously?
sentences.zh: TC：这个“摄影师”会自主录制吗？

sentences.en: If so, couldn't that be a privacy concern?
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，这难道不是一个隐私问题吗？

blocks.html_en: Insta360: This is one of the most important questions in the age of AI hardware. Our view is that future intelligent imaging devices should be able to automate recording much more deeply — even to the point of capturing everything the user wants preserved — but always under the user’s authorization and control.

sentences.en: Insta360: This is one of the most important questions in the age of AI hardware.
sentences.zh: Insta360：这是AI硬件时代最重要的问题之一。

sentences.en: Our view is that future intelligent imaging devices should be able to automate recording much more deeply — even to the point of capturing everything the user wants preserved — but always under the user’s authorization and control.
sentences.zh: 我们的观点是，未来的智能成像设备应该能够更深入地自动记录，甚至能够捕获用户想要保留的所有内容，但始终处于用户的授权和控制之下。

blocks.html_en: The core idea behind cameraman is not uncontrolled, limitless recording. It’s about turning the camera from a manually operated tool into an intelligent companion that understands what the user wants to capture and helps do that more effectively. That may require environmental awareness and autonomous recording when the user explicitly enables them, but those capabilities should always be bounded by clear user intent, permissions, and controls.

sentences.en: The core idea behind cameraman is not uncontrolled, limitless recording.
sentences.zh: 摄影师背后的核心理念并不是不受控制、无限的记录。

sentences.en: It’s about turning the camera from a manually operated tool into an intelligent companion that understands what the user wants to capture and helps do that more effectively.
sentences.zh: 它将相机从手动操作工具转变为智能伴侣，了解用户想要捕捉的内容并帮助更有效地实现这一目标。

sentences.en: That may require environmental awareness and autonomous recording when the user explicitly enables them, but those capabilities should always be bounded by clear user intent, permissions, and controls.
sentences.zh: 当用户明确启用这些功能时，这可能需要环境意识和自主记录，但这些功能应始终受到明确的用户意图、权限和控制的限制。

blocks.html_en: In other words, autonomy is important, but user agency is essential. We believe that’s the right balance for the future of intelligent imaging.

sentences.en: In other words, autonomy is important, but user agency is essential.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，自主权很重要，但用户代理也必不可少。

sentences.en: We believe that’s the right balance for the future of intelligent imaging.
sentences.zh: 我们相信这是智能成像未来的正确平衡。

blocks.html_en: TC: Does Insta360 envision the system ultimately replacing professional content creators, or is the vision aimed at consumers?

sentences.en: TC: Does Insta360 envision the system ultimately replacing professional content creators, or is the vision aimed at consumers?
sentences.zh: TC：Insta360 的愿景是最终取代专业内容创作者，还是面向消费者？

blocks.html_en: Insta360: No — this is not about replacing photographers, videographers, or creators. It is mainly about helping consumers capture moments more easily, with less friction and less fear of missing the shot.

sentences.en: Insta360: No — this is not about replacing photographers, videographers, or creators.
sentences.zh: Insta360：不——这并不是要取代摄影师、摄像师或创作者。

sentences.en: It is mainly about helping consumers capture moments more easily, with less friction and less fear of missing the shot.
sentences.zh: 它主要是为了帮助消费者更轻松地捕捉瞬间，减少摩擦，减少错过镜头的恐惧。

blocks.html_en: For professionals, we see these capabilities as assistive tools, not substitutes for human creativity. Great photography and filmmaking still depend on judgment, storytelling, taste, and human connection. Our goal is to reduce technical friction in capture, not replace the creator behind the camera.

sentences.en: For professionals, we see these capabilities as assistive tools, not substitutes for human creativity.
sentences.zh: 对于专业人士来说，我们将这些能力视为辅助工具，而不是人类创造力的替代品。

sentences.en: Great photography and filmmaking still depend on judgment, storytelling, taste, and human connection.
sentences.zh: 伟大的摄影和电影制作仍然取决于判断力、讲故事、品味和人际关系。

sentences.en: Our goal is to reduce technical friction in capture, not replace the creator behind the camera.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是减少捕捉过程中的技术摩擦，而不是取代相机背后的创作者。

sentences.en: The Luna Ultra now works with a POV Head Tracker (see the device in the man's ear), which synchronizes head and camera movement, truly freeing up the user for hands-free immersive POV shots.
sentences.zh: Luna Ultra 现在可与 POV 头部跟踪器（参见人耳中的设备）配合使用，同步头部和相机运动，真正解放用户，实现免提沉浸式 POV 拍摄。

sentences.en: (Image credit: Insta360)
sentences.zh: （图片来源：Insta360）

blocks.html_en: The right side of the line?

sentences.en: The right side of the line?
sentences.zh: 线的右侧？

blocks.html_en: It remains to be seen just how autonomous Insta360 cameras could become, but Insta360's response somewhat allays my fears about where its camera tech could be heading. And I get the logic — the ease of use and streamlined workflow of Insta360's consumer cameras in particular, which include leading 360-degree and vlogging cameras, are integral to their success.

sentences.en: It remains to be seen just how autonomous Insta360 cameras could become, but Insta360's response somewhat allays my fears about where its camera tech could be heading.
sentences.zh: Insta360 相机的自主化程度还有待观察，但 Insta360 的回应在一定程度上缓解了我对其相机技术未来发展方向的担忧。

sentences.en: And I get the logic — the ease of use and streamlined workflow of Insta360's consumer cameras in particular, which include leading 360-degree and vlogging cameras, are integral to their success.
sentences.zh: 我明白了其中的逻辑——特别是 Insta360 消费类相机（包括领先的 360 度和视频博客相机）的易用性和简化的工作流程，是其成功不可或缺的一部分。

blocks.html_en: Cameras such as the Insta360 X5, and Insta360's companion app are already packed with smart tools that make 360-degree video content easier to capture and edit. So, thinking ahead, why make the process unnecessarily difficult for the sake of user agency, when an intelligent camera knows which direction to point in?

sentences.en: Cameras such as the Insta360 X5, and Insta360's companion app are already packed with smart tools that make 360-degree video content easier to capture and edit.
sentences.zh: Insta360 X5 等相机和 Insta360 的配套应用程序已经配备了智能工具，使 360 度视频内容更容易捕捉和编辑。

sentences.en: So, thinking ahead, why make the process unnecessarily difficult for the sake of user agency, when an intelligent camera knows which direction to point in?

content_html_zh:
Insta360创始人兼首席执行官刘靖康（又名“JK”）最近在中国社交媒体平台微博上分享了一篇可能引起争议的帖子，翻译如下：

“我们的产品愿景是打造‘摄影师’——一款智能摄影机器人，能够像专业摄影师一样自动构图、捕捉瞬间，让用户完全沉浸在当下。

“如今，人工智能正在迅速发展，我们相信摄影师的‘大脑’正在变得越来越强大，为创意成像带来新的可能性。

“从长远来看，相机的理想最终状态是逐渐变得难以察觉，甚至‘消失’，直到记录不再耗费精力，成为生活中自然的一部分。”

作为一名关心此事的摄影师（以及作为关心此事的人），我对该帖子进行了回复，并请求 Insta360 发表评论。

JK 向我提供了一份声明，解决了我的担忧并阐述了他的愿景，他和 Insta360 还回答了我向他们提出的一些具体问题，涉及该公司未来相机可能改变游戏规则的计划。

下面是 JK 的回应，以及我对 JK 和 Insta360 发言人的采访。

订阅突发新闻、评论、观点、顶级技术交易等。

JK 的回应：我一直相信影像满足人类的三个基本需求：记录、分享和创造。

人工智能无疑将重塑这个行业的部分内容，特别是在共享和商业创作方面。 但当谈到记录我们的生活时，我相信人工智能有一条无法跨越的界限。 技术可以使工具更易于使用，但它无法取代真正有意义的工作背后的人类品质——判断力、情感、品味以及来自生活经验的创造力。

对我来说，我为女儿的微笑拍摄的照片是无价的，不是因为技术完美，而是因为我就在那里。 那一刻我感觉到了。 人工智能可以生成、增强和模仿，但它不能代表我们体验生活。

人是万物的尺度。 你不应该把本该属于你的经验交给算法和机器。

因此，当我们谈论相机的未来时，我们并不是在谈论取代人。 我们正在谈论构建帮助人们更自由、更自然、更少摩擦地捕捉生活的工具。 未来不是让机器变得更加人性化，而是帮助人类更加活在当下、更具创造力、更加自我。

采访

TC：这位“摄影师”长什么样？ 是一个实体还是多个产品？

JK：对我们来说，未来的摄影师是一个产品愿景，而不是一个单一的设备。

Insta360：核心理念是创建一款能够自动构图、捕捉关键时刻并为用户生成成品内容的相机，让人们能够完全沉浸在当下而不会错过重要的事情。

当您旅行或观看现场活动时，您通常会一直拿着手机，看屏幕而不是体验本身。 我们的长期愿景是让相机更像专业摄影师：您留在现场，它可以帮助您进行拍摄。

我们仍在探索理想的外形尺寸，因此短期内不会有最终的最终产品。 但我们已经将这一愿景的元素带入现有产品中。 例如，Luna Ultra 的 POV 头部跟踪器可实现更加无缝、几乎隐形的拍摄体验，我们将其视为未来摄影师的重要早期形式。

TC：我们是否认为“智能摄影机器人”将是完全自动化和独立的？

Insta360：首先需要澄清的是，未来的摄影师并不是指人形机器人。 这是一个产品概念，也是相机如何发展的长期愿景。

其想法是将用户从复杂的操作中解放出来，这样他们就可以真正享受当下，同时仍然获得专业的结果。 从这个意义上说，相机开始更多地扮演摄影师的角色。 想象一次家庭郊游，系统可以自动端到端地构图、捕捉、编辑和输出内容，而无需有人不断管理设备。

也就是说，这并不是说相机在没有用户的情况下独立运行。 这是关于在用户指导、意图和控制下的高度智能操作。 相机应该能够自动化更多的过程，包括在用户想要的时候进行全面记录，但始终在用户设置的范围内。 我们的目标是让体验变得轻松自然——甚至在日常生活中几乎察觉不到相机的存在。

TC：您能描述一下构图、拍摄和剪辑功能吗？

Insta360：要打造未来的摄影师，相机需要做好三件事：观察、理解和行动。

首先，它需要看到更多的世界。 这就是 360 度成像对我们如此重要的原因之一。 传统相机只能捕捉窄幅画面，而 360 度相机则捕捉整个场景。 这为用户和人工智能提供了更多的背景信息，降低了错过重要时刻的风险，并为跟踪、重构和场景理解奠定了更坚实的基础。

其次，它需要空间智能。 相机必须了解深度、运动、方向以及环境中发生的事情——不仅仅是记录像素，而是实际解释场景。

第三，它需要实时行动。 这意味着跟踪拍摄对象、稳定镜头、构图、预测运动，并最终根据用户的意图自动做出更明智的拍摄决策。 如果它不能立即做出反应，它就不像一个摄影师。

JK：摄影师处于传感、设备上人工智能和计算成像的交叉点。 我们的目标是让相机不再只是一个记录工具，而开始成为一个积极的创意伙伴。

TC：您能否介绍一下正在探索的一项特定的未来功能，该功能将引导 Insta360 的相机成为“积极的创意合作伙伴”？

Insta360：当我们谈论“活跃的创意合作伙伴”时，我们指的是能够更好地理解场景并帮助用户更智能地捕捉场景的智能成像解决方案。 在动态环境中，它可以在用户干预较少的情况下跟上拍摄对象，因此人们可以在相机处理更多技术工作的同时专注于瞬间。

为了支持这一愿景，我们已经建立了强大的技术基础，包括全景生成和全景度量深度模型。 我们已经将这些技术开源给业界，它们不仅在360度摄像机上有潜在的应用，在其他产品和领域也有潜在的应用。

TC：“摄影师”与现有相机和 Insta360 型号有何不同？

Insta360：Insta360 已经具备了未来摄影师所需的一些基础功能。 AI 拼接、FlowState 稳定、主题跟踪、重新取景、自动编辑和设备内图像处理等功能都是相机向更智能和自主拍摄方向发展的一部分。 也就是说，今天的产品仍然是完全实现的体验的早期版本。

我们花费数年时间在 360 度成像领域积累了深厚的专业知识，这为我们在空间智能方面奠定了坚实的基础。 与仅记录单帧的传统相机相比，360 度成像数据提供了完整的视野和连续的空间背景。 结合我们在空间建模和生成智能方面的工作，这有助于人工智能从简单地“看到”世界转向真正理解世界。

这是我们对成像未来的看法的一个关键区别。 展望未来，我们将继续投资全景深度估计、世界模型和自主跟随系统等领域。

TC：这位“摄影师”的拍摄时间是多少？

Insta360：这是一个长期的愿景，我们期望通过随着时间的推移不断的产品迭代来实现它。 我们看到它并不是一次性在单一产品中实现，而是随着底层技术的成熟并为实际使用做好准备而逐步发展。

您知道 TechRadar 现在有会员资格吗？

只需单击本页顶部的“立即加入”即可成为 TechRadar 内部人士。 有问题吗？ 请发送电子邮件至membership@techradar.com

TC：这个“摄影师”会自主录制吗？ 如果是这样，这难道不是一个隐私问题吗？

Insta360：这是AI硬件时代最重要的问题之一。 我们的观点是，未来的智能成像设备应该能够更深入地自动记录，甚至能够捕获用户想要保留的所有内容，但始终处于用户的授权和控制之下。

摄影师背后的核心理念并不是不受控制、无限的记录。 它将相机从手动操作工具转变为智能伴侣，了解用户想要捕捉的内容并帮助更有效地实现这一目标。 当用户明确启用这些功能时，这可能需要环境意识和自主记录，但这些功能应始终受到明确的用户意图、权限和控制的限制。

换句话说，自主权很重要，但用户代理也必不可少。 我们相信这是智能成像未来的正确平衡。

TC：Insta360 的愿景是最终取代专业内容创作者，还是面向消费者？

Insta360：不——这并不是要取代摄影师、摄像师或创作者。 它主要是为了帮助消费者更轻松地捕捉瞬间，减少摩擦，减少错过镜头的恐惧。

对于专业人士来说，我们将这些能力视为辅助工具，而不是人类创造力的替代品。 伟大的摄影和电影制作仍然取决于判断力、讲故事、品味和人际关系。 我们的目标是减少捕捉过程中的技术摩擦，而不是取代相机背后的创作者。

线的右侧？

Insta360 相机的自主化程度还有待观察，但 Insta360 的回应在一定程度上缓解了我对其相机技术未来发展方向的担忧。 我明白了其中的逻辑——特别是 Insta360 消费类相机（包括领先的 360 度和视频博客相机）的易用性和简化的工作流程，是其成功不可或缺的一部分。

Insta360 X5 等相机和 Insta360 的配套应用程序已经配备了智能工具，使 360 度视频内容更容易捕捉和编辑。 那么，提前思考一下，当智能相机知道指向哪个方向时，为什么要为了用户代理而让这个过程变得不必要的困难呢？

当 AI 知道最佳动作发生在哪里并可以为您建议/进行编辑时，为什么要倒出冗长的 360 度视频剪辑来手动拼凑编辑呢？

正是人类创造力和自动化人工智能工具的交集，我们可能会开始看到更多智能功能，帮助用户拍摄、编辑和分享，让他们像 JK 所说的那样“更加专注于当下”，而不是陷入相机操作的困境。 如果说有哪家公司能够推进这种智能相机技术，那就是 Insta360。
